notes: Whole cooperative table for every core player, not only one hero identity and an encounter box.
Neutral original geometry contains no commercial character image, logo or card wording.
Printed setup/ally limits are not enforced scene capacities; actual observed irregular or partial state remains representable.
Current app field names are hints only; this package supplies assets and self-contained JSON, not product integration.
Later expansions and current Rules Reference changes are not silently applied to this 2019 structural edition.

structureEvidence.location: Publisher core product/support entry; legacy URL now redirects to product-lines hub
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Use linked original core rulebook as edition authority rather than inferring structure from current expansions.

structureEvidence.location: Original core Learn to Play (2019), p.3 inventory; pp.5–9 setup/table/ready; p.11 identity/in-play; pp.15–18 villain boost, encounters and card types
structureEvidence.access: pinned local PDF; page text and rendered table/component diagrams directly viewed
structureEvidence.verifiedFacts: Separate villain and scheme stages, encounter piles, hero/alter-ego face versus exhaustion, player-engaged minions, player in-play/hand/deck/discard, targeted tokens/status, hidden boost/encounter cards, set-aside nemesis, 1–4 players.

assetScope: 2019 core cooperative whole table, 1–4 heroes: scenario/stages/schemes, every player identity/in-play/engagement/hand/deck/discard, hidden pending cards, counters/status and resumable checkpoint. Assets only.

tableModel.edition: 2019 original core set; not a silent migration to later Rules Reference/expansion rules

coordinates.playerScene: unbounded scene per player; overview bounds are viewports, not capacity limits
coordinates.orientation: rotation in degrees about physical card centre; upright=0, exhausted commonly90; printed landscape is separate from exhaustion

identityAxes.invariant: Flipping identity preserves exhaustion, damage, statuses and attached upgrades unless an explicitly recorded effect changes them. Never replace one axis with the other.

ownership.attachedToId: physical parent card; distinct from owner/controller
ownership.orphanPolicy: preserve unresolved relationship as null, never assign to nearest hero automatically

fieldBindings.enemy.scene: scenario and shared public card/counter scene

tableModel.privateState: Hands/deck orders and unrevealed encounter/boost identities are not exposed by the overview. Unknown IDs may retain count and face without inventing a printed card. Public visibility is not inferred from a public field-binding hint.

cardLayout.attachments: relative x/y/layer and attachedToId chain; parent movement carries child while preserving local transform
cardLayout.variableZones: expand scene/camera to actual bounding box, not an arbitrary grid or fixed ally count
cardLayout.orderedPiles: orderedCardIds bottom-to-top; front/back and revealed state retained per card

tableModel.resumeSemantics: Preserve current villain/main-scheme stages, first player, active player, hero face, all physical cards/relationships, exact counters including0 and unknown null, and unresolved action/boost/encounter window. No replay of effects on reopening.
tableModel.ruleAutomation: No effect resolution, damage/cost calculation, deckbuilding, legality validation or expansion support is promised.

completeStructures: shared villain and main-scheme stage stacks with active faces
variable side schemes and villain attachments
encounter deck/discard and transient boost/reveal cards
all four hero identities, HP dials and face/exhaustion state
all private hands/decks, public discards and out-of-play cards
diagramOnly: neutral example card silhouettes are not setup objects or capacity
four stations are maximum core players, inactive stations can be hidden

auxiliaryAssets.purpose: Original neutral templates: ready/exhausted rotation, hero/alter-ego face, attachment and token targeting. No printed commercial card art.
